messages.message: Crew: duty assignments and maintenance requests are available in Station Applications. Keep investigation notes in your personal memo.
Morning, crew. Check the Scheduled Tasks Module before starting your shift, and submit equipment problems through Maintenance tickets.
Medical reminder: coffee is not a substitute for sleep. Neither is telling me you feel “mostly operational.” You are a person, not a ventilation fan.
Please stop moving items in the research lab to “more sensible places.” Their current arrangement is deliberate. Whether it is sensible is a separate discussion.
Good discussion. Please apply this level of attention to your actual duties. And whoever labelled the airlock “Suggestions,” remove it.
